name: Rio Grande do Norte
flagName: Flag of Rio Grande do Norte
summary: Green over white with the state arms: a coconut palm and a carnaúba palm, sugarcane, cotton and a jangada sailing on the sea.
origin: The folklorist Luís da Câmara Cascudo designed the flag, adopted on 3 December 1957.

history.label: State of Rio Grande do Norte

facts: The state produces most of Brazil's sea salt.
Natal, the capital, was named for Christmas, when it was founded.
clues: Green over white with a shield of palms and a raft.
Its capital is named after Christmas.
